references.text: This is the original instruction from God to Moses regarding making the tabernacle boards from acacia wood. Exodus 36:20 describes the execution of this command.
Acacia wood (עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים) was also used for the ark of the covenant, showing that this type of wood was the preferred material for the holy objects of the tabernacle.
Continuation of the description of the construction of the boards, with measurements and details on how they were assembled.
The sons of Merari were responsible for the boards of the tabernacle (קַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן), demonstrating the Levitical service associated with these boards.
Describes the responsibility of the Merarites to carry the boards of the tabernacle during the wilderness journey.
Complementary construction elements: The boards provide height and structure, while the crossbars ensure stability.
Fulfillment of instruction: The actual execution confirms obedience to the original divine command.
Structural detail: The specification of corner boards shows how the general boards form a stable corner.
Narrative detail: Specification of the number and direction of the generally mentioned boards.
